en.q1: How much does API access cost?
en.a1: Enter any positive whole USD top-up amount. Each request is converted to official API spend, then your active discount is applied: B2C takes a flat 50% off every request, while B2B pricing is negotiated.

en.a6: Honor Retry-After and reduce concurrency. Dashboard key guardrails are a lifetime spending limit and an optional expiration date; they do not configure request throughput.
